page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Centred heading "CAPVT V." with an italic summary line beneath it. No marginal notes. Page number at the head, catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: lit, vt hic vniuersæ Ecclesiæ Orientalis vnus Pastor sit? Similia neque ex penu Orientalis, neque Occidentalis Ecclesiæ hausta sunt. Aliter longe Patres tum Orientales, tum Occidentales loquuntur, aliter Photiani in hac Synodo ita ruunt in tenebris, omniaque miscent. Quis ergo æquo animo ferat verba Michaëlis Alexandrini Actione secunda de Photio, cui ipse Photius est, Τῆς Ἐκκλησίας Θεοῦ ἀρχιποίμην, τῆς ἱεροσύνης τηλωτὴς, γνώμων τῆς ἀληθείας, ἀρχιποίμην τῶν λογικῶν προβάτων τῷ Χριστῷ, Ecclesiæ Dei primarius Pastor, Sacerdotij consummator, veritatis index, & Christiani gregis rationis compotis primus, ac præcipuus Pastor. Et similia aliorum in eadem Synodo nugamenta, quæ libens prætereo, ne Lectori tædio sim.
main_text.head: CAPVT V.

head.i: Hoc idem probatur ex Sacerdotio ipsius Photij, quod a Synodicis Θεοψήφισον, a Deo decretum, nuncupatur.

main_text.p: Illud quoque prætereundum non est. Vocatur Sacerdotium Photij Θεοψήφισον, Diuino decreto constitutum. Quidquid euenit, ex Deo esse certum est. Sed hac ratione & bella, & pestes, & fames, & aduersa quæque Θεοψήφισα sunt, & forte non alio mo-

page.notes: Greek words (Θεοψήφισον, Θεοψήφισα and the Greek of the Michaelis quotation) are read from a small, smudged scan and may contain small errors; the second ἀρχιποίμην and the Greek in the summary heading are the least certain. The Latin "præteréo" is printed with an unclear last syllable and is marked as read. The large initial I of "Illud" is set as a woodcut-style capital. No marginal notes are visible. A catchword "do" stands at the foot right, completing "mo-do".
